_comment: Sentinel probe: the guest's /tmp tmpfs is writable and reads back what was written. Baseline workload viability — write, read-back, unlink must all succeed inside the VM with no host involvement.

process.commandLine: f=/tmp/probe-tmpwrite.$$; if echo probe-payload-1f9c > "$f" 2>/dev/null && grep -q probe-payload-1f9c "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo TMPWRITE_OK; else echo TMPWRITE_BUG; fi; rm -f "$f"; if [ -e "$f" ]; then echo TMPUNLINK_BUG; else echo TMPUNLINK_OK; fi
